story: Captain Finley and his friends set sail to find the legendary Golden Treasure. A storm and a pirate named Captain Grump made their journey difficult. They sailed through the storm and reached the island safely. They solved the conflict and found a chest full of treasure. They shared the treasure and celebrated their teamwork and friendship.
